WEBSITE PRIVACY INFORMATION · 12 OCTOBER 2026

Your enquiry.
Handled with clarity.

What this website does

This website introduces FirmVault, a product by Nexosk Group Private Limited. Its interface examples use fictional records. The website does not provide a client document upload facility.

Demo enquiries

The demo form prepares an email using the name, firm name, email address, and any optional details you enter. It opens your chosen email application. You decide whether to send the message to contact@nexosk.in.

The form does not send those fields to a FirmVault server or save them in browser storage. When you send an email, the information you include is used to respond to your enquiry and arrange a conversation. Your email service also handles that message under its own terms.

Theme preference

If you select a colour theme, this website saves that choice in your browser so it can remember it on your next visit. The default setting follows your system’s appearance.

Hosting and other services

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub handles hosting requests under its own data practices. No advertising or website analytics scripts have been added to this version.

Client records and the product

This information covers the marketing website. Before using FirmVault with client records, discuss the product’s applicable data handling, access, retention, and commercial arrangements with the team. Please do not include confidential client documents in a demo enquiry.

Questions

For questions about a website enquiry or your information, contact contact@nexosk.in.
